about: Every airport's floor recorded live on 2026-10-19 on v24067 (#1062), at 1920x1080 (31 boards with rows; the 32nd, Roberval, showed no flights and draws no floor), and the floors recorded on v24067 the same evening by the second pass, its arrivals pass and the rechecks (14): the view each was drawn in, its size, the moment and the board's languages; the page's places as this build reads them, in the order of the page's rows (code, lat, lon, zone, name, every language's name, flights, flown, next), as in tests/fixtures/earth-sweep-2026-10-19.json, with the one place the same board's strip named in the same second where the map drew no name larger. Positions, zones and names are this build's (v24070). Also what main (v24067) named on main's own page, measured with the board's font; which of those names were in a conflict there (by another place's dot or arrow, nearer another place's mark than its own however little, another place's route under the name, a line through a name, two names touching); and each route of another place that ran under one of main's names (main.under, [name, route]). The font: the board's, as the floor measures it. tests/earth-floor-sweep.test.js

font.about: Bricolage Grotesque (fids-current/fonts/bricolage, the board's font) at weight 700, width 100, optical size = the pixel size, as the floor draws its names: each character's advance and each pair's kerning in units of 1/1000 em, read from the repo's woff2 subsets with fontTools; the floor's textW adds 0.01 em a letter and 0.2 em. (The comma and the kerning of AU were added for a name with its country: 'Hamilton, Australia', 'Hamilton, AU'.) Chrome's canvas measureText agrees within 0.15 px.
